statement: A staged change's shadow window closes only when the instances' samples that compared (not BASE_MISMATCH) reach the minimum after the minimum duration and every instance with a status in the last minute that takes part in shadowing acknowledges the window in that status (an instance that sends no acknowledgements, an older version or one holding no staged list, acknowledges nothing; an instance whose status says it does not shadow, its candidate source not CoSec's own, is not waited for, and still counts for propagation), or at the maximum duration as insufficient whatever the acknowledgements; a stage makes the staged list kept, so a window staged on a store no startup task or shadow pass ran on is acknowledged too; an acknowledgement adds no sample, statuses that cannot be read keep the window open, and a change still shadowing never publishes. While the window is open, the change's answer says how many live instances acknowledge it and which do not (`waitingFor`: at most twenty ids and the count of the rest).
